name: Infantry_Sites
author: Infantry AI
description: The Infantry AI Hosting dashboard (opened from the Services tab): your hosting servers (read-only: online or offline) with Infantry AI Hosting, and a tool for agents to list them.

tools.name: infantry_sites_list
tools.description: List your hosting servers (id, name, status, ip, region, size, createdAt, destroyAt).

tools.name: infantry_sites_ssh_exec
tools.description: Run a shell command on one of your hosting servers over SSH (no setup: device key + short-lived certificate).

tools.name: infantry_sites_ssh_upload
tools.description: Write a small text file on one of your hosting servers over SSH.

knowledge.summary: Infantry AI Hosting (Services tab): user signs in, subscribes, server appears; agents use infantry_sites_list, infantry_sites_ssh_exec, infantry_sites_ssh_upload. Read for states and fixes.
